tableLines.line: You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.

👂 Overheard — Marcus (to A man, maybe 60s): "Hannah's story has a fresh coat of paint." Marcus taps the table. "Scrape it off and you get from Seoul, South Korea. Just don't scrape it in front of them."
✨ Ability gained: Long Table (L1). Share food with everyone in camp to reduce their hunger. Costs 300 kcal; once a day.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
✨ Ability gained: Harvest Table (L1). Your feasts are rituals. Every feast you host arms the feast surge even without devotion (x1.3 at least), and each guest leaves trusting you a little more.
"THE TABLE IS SET. THE VILLAGE IS ONE ANIMAL. IT IS VERY WELL FED AND IT WOULD LIKE TO HIT SOMETHING."
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Marcus speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.

◈ OVERTIME ×1 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+25% HP, +12% damage). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −7. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock. The wait stretches — the village's standing buys time: 21 days between tiers, not 7.

◈ OVERTIME ×2 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+50% HP, +24% damage, +1 to every pack). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −17. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock. The wait stretches — the village's standing buys time: 23 days between tiers, not 7.

The sky changed three weeks later. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they have carried you this far. The feast was the weapon.
